notes.title: "Star Shift: Rebellion" Has Launched! Join The Rebellion!
notes.content:
We're thrilled to announce that the next chapter in the Star Shift Saga, "[b]Star Shift: Rebellion[/b]," has been launched! Now's your chance to pick up a copy of your own! Launch the Rebellion from your PC!

[previewyoutube=LGeaASEtfK8;full][/previewyoutube]

Infernis Prime: a mining colony on the edge of the Outer Rim, languishes under a brutal occupation. Within the shadows of this forsaken world, a spark of hope flickers. With the help of a hacked android and the discovery of a dark secret, the seeds of the future take root. "Star Shift: Rebellion" unfolds with the gripping tale of the Outer Rim Coalition's formation and their quest for liberation.

[b]The Saga Begins:[/b] Today, you are invited to step into a universe where the fabric of reality is not what it seems, and the line between right and wrong blurs with each revelation. Will you rise as the beacon of hope in a galaxy consumed by darkness? Or will you forge a path of power, regardless of the cost? The legacy of "Star Shift: Rebellion" is not written in the stars but by the hands of those brave enough to take the helm.

[b]Chart Your Course: [/b]Beyond the rebellion, beyond the fight for freedom, lies the truth to alter the course of history. Engage in strategic combat that challenges both your intellect and your resolve. Navigate alliances, uncover secrets, and make decisions that will define the legacy of the Outer Rim Coalition.

The universe of "Star Shift: Rebellion" awaits. Are you ready to uncover the truth, join the fight, and lead the rebellion? Chart Your Course: [b]Join the Rebellion Today![/b]. 

[h2]Epic Space Opera Storyline:[/h2]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1824040/Star_Shift_Rebellion/][img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1824040/extras/epic-space-opera-storyline.gif[/img][/url]

- Time has been shattered. Only you and your crew can unlock the mystery before it's too late!

[h2]Strategic Turn-Based Combat:[/h2]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1824040/Star_Shift_Rebellion/][img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1824040/extras/Strategic-Turn-Based-Combat-SSR.gif[/img][/url]

- A Mashup of tactical RPG and turn-based strategy elements... with a sci-fi twist!

[h2]Tactical Fleet Combat:[/h2]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1824040/Star_Shift_Rebellion/][img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1824040/extras/tactical-fleet-combat.gif[/img][/url]

[h2]A Diverse Cast Of  Playable Characters:[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41524194/13bc9dc3e1658c234d7e3d16e3aabf2ab889626a.png[/img]

-A diverse cast of playable characters with unique skill trees to complement your play-style.

[h2]Complex Skill Tree System:[/h2]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1824040/Star_Shift_Rebellion/][img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1824040/extras/complex-skill-tree-system.gif[/img][/url]

notes.title: Star Shift Origins - International Edition Released!
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce that Star Shift Origins - International Edition has been released! 

[previewyoutube=HyBAQC9IVxM;full][/previewyoutube]

The game is now available in six languages:

1. English
2. Spanish
3. Russian
4. Japanese
5. Simplified Chinese
6. Traditional Chinese

The translations were done by our team of one, if you speak any of these languages and you find any bugs or mistakes in the translation, please let us know and we'll get it resolved. 

[b]Star Shift Origins has now become available absolutely free![/b] If you haven't had a chance to catch up on the story, definitely give it a shot!

We are also excited to announce that Star Shift Rebellion (the next game in the series) has a set release date of January 31st, 2024. 

Wishlist Star Shift Rebellion on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1824040/Star_Shift_Rebellion/

[previewyoutube=5R-Wi7BOmgw;full][/previewyoutube]

We are also pleased to announce Star Shift Freelancers, coming in late 2024:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2176490/Star_Shift_Freelancers/

2024 is going to be an exciting year for Star Shift! We look forward to seeing you on the other side!

notes.title: Various Bug Fixes
notes.content:
— The game folders now has a full, concise PDF walkthrough with no spoilers!
— Player characters now face in the direction of the shop machines instead of
elsewhere...
— Player characters now face in the direction of various items instead of
elsewhere...
— The lift at the Research Facility has an update for the "same floor issue."
(Before this update, the same floor would yield an extra lift ride...)
— The Titan and Fighter Drone are no longer AI-controlled in the second tactical
battle.
— Some typos and the blunder of where Archer is actually title as an ESA
technician, got fixed.
— RAXION II Landing Site passability issue fixed.
— Weird passability tiles at the Research Facility got fixed.
— Player characters face up when entering and leaving Keskus Temple Courtyard,
even when approached facing left or right.
— Various Keskus Temple Courtyard water passability issues and alien font issue,
fixed.
— The other Kenjaros at the Keskus Temple no longer "interfere" with the first cut
scene.
— After various criticism about this, the beginning of the game has a brief
"guide."
— Various other presentation issues and bugs, fixed

notes.title: Star Shift Origins Has Been Released!
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce the Star Shift Origins has been released! Pick up your copy today!

"Star Shift Origins tells the story of the first crew of the Dauntless. Trapped in an alternate reality and on the run, the crew desperately searches for answers while being hunted by the relentless Earth Systems Alliance (ESA)."

[previewyoutube=xwY901-Kpks;full][/previewyoutube]

FEATURES:

[h1]STRATEGIC TURN BASED COMBAT:[/h1]

[url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC4pkhNirMTaVLy0gEaPulXQ/videos][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1706310/extras/ezgif.com-gif-maker.gif?t=1636392478[/img][/url]

Star Shift Origins features a turn-based active time combat system with a maximum party size of 7 and multiple playable characters. There are no levels in Star Shift, instead skills and stat increases are managed by knowledge points acquired from battle which are used to gain new skills and increase stats. Victory in combat relies on the player being strategic to achieve the desired outcome.

[h1]TACTICAL FLEET COMBAT:[/h1]

[url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC4pkhNirMTaVLy0gEaPulXQ/videos][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1706310/extras/tactical-fleet-combat.gif?t=1636392478[/img][/url]

In addition to the standard turn-based combat, Star Shift also implements a tactical battle system for fleet and army combat.

[h1]COMPLEX SKILL TREE SYSTEM:[/h1]

[url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC4pkhNirMTaVLy0gEaPulXQ/videos][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1706310/extras/complex-skill-tree-system.gif?t=1636392478[/img][/url]

Star Shift implements a complex skill tree system. Customize your characters with unique skills and abilities. Increase stats through passive skills, or learn active skills. Unique skill trees exist depending on the species of the character, as well as their class.

[h1]EPIC SPACE OPERA STORYLINE:[/h1]

[url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC4pkhNirMTaVLy0gEaPulXQ/videos][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1706310/extras/epic-space-opera-storyline.gif?t=1636392478[/img][/url]

Time has been shattered, only you and your crew can unlock the mystery and correct the damage, before it's too late.

[h1]GREAT SOUNDTRACK - MULTIPLE ARTISTS:[/h1]

[url=https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLLnv3EACRAXu9vm2koTnSynShOb6PK1rU][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1706310/extras/Multiple-independent-artists.gif?t=1636392478[/img][/url]

An incredible soundtrack from multiple independent artists will keep the player engaged and in the moment.
